scope: 15 provider/business-model classes, not an exhaustive inventory of all ad companies or guaranteed acceptance; pricing/revshare not inferred from marketing

rows.name: Google AdSense
rows.known_requirements: Account/site verification, original value/navigation, reachable crawler, Google Publisher Policies, ads.txt and eligible region consent; no published fixed universal minimum traffic required
rows.caveat: approval must come from owner account; ad code presence is not approval

rows.name: Journey by Mediavine
rows.known_requirements: Publisher requirements changed Nov 18 2026; current minimum and Grow/site measurement rules must be re-read; content quality and traffic composition
rows.caveat: Do not reuse outdated 10000 sessions/30-day Grow rule

rows.name: Mediavine Official
rows.known_requirements: At least 5000 USD annual ad revenue and high-quality original content/premium reader experience; contract exclusivity may apply
rows.caveat: Ad revenue threshold is not visits or CTR and not automatic approval

rows.name: Raptive
rows.known_requirements: For 25k–99,999 PV 50% US/UK/CA/NZ/AU, majority long-form content, 6 month domain, original human involvement and correctly configured Analytics; >=100k threshold geo ratio 40%
rows.caveat: Utility-only sites without majority long-form content may be ineligible despite 25k PV

rows.name: EzoicAds
rows.known_requirements: Integration, advertiser content quality, current acceptance and supported traffic sources require provider review; no universal minimum confirmed here
rows.caveat: Do not claim guaranteed instant acceptance

rows.name: Media.net
rows.known_requirements: Primarily organic traffic, truthful inventory, content rights, nonincentivized clicks and partner/payout agreement
rows.caveat: Treat requirements beyond disclosed policy as unknown

rows.name: Freestar
rows.known_requirements: Typically 1M monthly pageviews, at least 50% organic audiences, moderated user content; current sales and screening requirements matter
rows.caveat: Typical is not strict numeric universal acceptance threshold

rows.name: Monetag
rows.known_requirements: Site content must respect copyrights/law, ad types can alter navigation, publisher terms/AdSense coexistence must be checked
rows.caveat: Popunders/redirect UX may be unsuitable or conflict with other networks

rows.name: Adsterra
rows.known_requirements: Provider marketing says no minimum traffic; site/traffic quality, actual terms, ad formats, malware/redirect risk and advertiser safety require checking
rows.caveat: No minimum ≠ guaranteed safe/approved or sustainable revenue

rows.name: Snigel
rows.known_requirements: Managed ad partner eligibility/rev share/terms require dated first-party agreement and account review

rows.name: Setupad
rows.known_requirements: Traffic threshold, region, exclusivity, approved ad sizes, rev share and contract not verified

rows.name: Google Ad Manager / AdX
rows.known_requirements: Ad Manager programmatic inventory and AdX access require legitimate agreement; GPT tagging is not an AdSense approval bypass
rows.caveat: Google Ad Manager is not a standalone automatic alternative to site quality approval

rows.name: Direct sponsorships
rows.known_requirements: Disclose commercial relationships, label ads, follow law/traffic privacy, invoice contracts and measure real conversion

rows.name: Affiliate programs
rows.known_requirements: Truthful relevant recommendations, disclosure and program rights, no fabricated reviews, track net conversions
rows.caveat: Not equivalent to CPM display revenue

rows.name: Freemium / metered APIs
rows.known_requirements: User-funded cloud CPU/AI/API tasks with authenticated limits, actual billing, privacy and refunds
rows.caveat: Billing service and privacy obligations must be validated

conditionals: For Raptive thresholds/geo percentages are specifically for documented tiers and require additional editorial/age/analytics gates. 'Mediavine exclusivity' should be reviewed in actual contract.
